text.en: NEGARA BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 22 CORRIGENDA In Government Gazette Part II Issue No. 11 dated 17th. October, 1985, in English version on page 120 the sentence, "Educations (Brunei Board of Examinations)" should read as "Education (Brunei Board of Examinations)" and on page 123 the sentence "Chronoiogical Table of Acts" should read as "Chronological Table of Acts".
